name: Alexis A.
quote: We had Love Is Blinds come over. The blinds we had in our home were old and were pretty damaged. Jake came out and took care of us from start to finish. We love the cordless blinds and our rooms look so different! Great overall experience!

name: Alexis A.
quote: We have three dogs and they had done a number on our blinds when they were pups. Now that they are older we decided it was time to update. We love our new blinds! We decided on cordless for pet and child safety reasons

name: Alexis A.
quote: Love Is Blinds sells the most beautiful custom built shades, blinds & more! They worked very hard to find the exact color and style I needed to fit my living room and bedrooms. I would highly recommend Jake & Jonathan as they went above & beyond to help me!

name: Jacob W.
quote: This really is a great company. You can tell that they really care about what they do and have a lot of knowledge. If you’re in the market for blinds, give these guys a call!

name: Alexis A.
quote: Dustin and Jake are highly qualified blind installers that know what they doing. Very informative and trustworthy through the whole process. Would definitely recommend this company for blinds!

name: Alexis A.
quote: Great products and great people. Everyone we worked with and talked to was friendly and the project was very smooth. We got cordless blinds for our living room, dining, and kitchen because they needed to be updated. Didn’t realize how big of a difference it would make. We are very pleased and would recommend them.
owner_reply: Thank you for the great review! We love what we do and are grateful we could assist you in this project, Alexis!

name: Alexis A.
quote: Love is blinds with super professional and very friendly. Our old blinds were so dusty and chewed up by the dogs, and our new blinds are so agile and smooth. They were super helpful during the Decision-making process. I highly recommend!
owner_reply: Alexis, thank you for your kind review! It means so much! We are thrilled that you had a great experience with Love Is Blinds, and that your blinds are working well! Thanks for trusting us with your home!
